title: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Health — Simple Present
titleVi: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Sức khỏe — Thì Hiện Tại Đơn

speakingCueCard.prompt: Do you do anything to stay healthy?
bulletPoints: What you do for your health
What kind of food you eat
Why health is important to you

questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
questionPromptVi: Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây. Chọn mỗi lỗi ngữ pháp bạn phát hiện bằng cách bôi đen. Bạn có thể gõ bản sửa đúng vào ô hiện ra.
passageText: Um, I try to stay healthy, but honestly it is not easy for me. Every morning, my mother cook breakfast with vegetables and rice, which I think is quite good for my body. I also walk to school instead of taking the bus because I enjoy the fresh air. Overall, I think health matter a lot, especially when you are young.

errors.explanation: 'My mother' is third-person singular, so the verb needs an -s ending: 'cooks', not 'cook'.
errors.explanationVi: 'My mother' là ngôi thứ ba số ít, nên động từ cần thêm -s: 'cooks', không phải 'cook'.

errors.explanation: 'Health' is an uncountable singular noun, so the verb needs -s: 'matters', not 'matter'.
errors.explanationVi: 'Health' là danh từ không đếm được số ít, nên động từ cần -s: 'matters', không phải 'matter'.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'I try' is correct — first person singular uses the base form of the verb in simple present.

collocations.exampleSentence: Doctors always recommend that people stay healthy by eating well and exercising.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Stay + adjective' — không dùng 'stay healthily' (trạng từ) ở đây

collocations.exampleSentence: Eating fresh fruit every day is really good for your body.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Good for + danh từ' — không dùng 'good to my body'

collocations.exampleSentence: Living near a park means I can enjoy the fresh air every morning.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Fresh air' — không dùng 'clean air' khi nói về không khí tự nhiên ngoài trời

collocations.exampleSentence: I walk to school every day because it only takes fifteen minutes.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Walk to + nơi' — không dùng 'walk to the school' trừ khi chỉ một trường cụ thể
